notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.notes:
[u][b]Noid 1.2 Changes : [/b][/u]

*  Added a touch of extra bounce to the physics materials.  Ball now bounces just that little bit more aggressively.  This increases the difficulty a bit yet lowers the amount of time that the ball sometimes spends close to a wall.  

*  Moved game options to their own toggleable UI section.

[i]In response to some critical feedback : [/i]

*  Added option to toggle the laser aim during serve.  Some players might find that having it enabled breaks immersion.

*  Added option to toggle paddle weight.  Players can now choose whether to play with the paddle being light as a feather or for it to have a small amount of simulated weight.

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.notes:
[u][b]Version 1.1 Changes[/b][/u]

*  Separated high scores for Easy, Normal and Hard Modes.  The high score for each level is now displayed according to the respective difficulty.

*  Added option for players to choose which hand to serve from.

*  Added option for players to swap Serve and Swap Paddle controls between Triggers and Grab Buttons.


Shout out to Steam user and Into The Noid player Zemkedan for these suggestions.

And to all, Merry Christmas!
